note: What to roll a riven FOR, judged mechanically rather than by what expensive rivens happen to carry. Multipliers and the never-negative list are from the official wiki; the negative-stat judgements are the community consensus that the app then filters per weapon. Edit freely — the app reloads it on restart.
sources: wiki.warframe.com Riven Mods (attribute table, roll-shape multipliers, disposition range, positive-only attributes)

itemku.com / immortalboost.com weapon build guides 2026 (archetype mod packages)

mechanics.why_a_negative_helps: A negative is not a penalty you tolerate — it is how you buy bigger positives. The same three positives roll 25% higher when a negative rides along (0.9375x against 0.75x), and the mod costs less to slot. A 3-positive riven with no negative is the weakest common shape in the game.

roll_shapes.note: the biggest per-stat numbers there are — ideal when the two stats you want are the only two that matter
the usual god-roll shape: three useful stats still rolling above a no-negative riven
clean but modest; fine on a weapon where every negative would hurt
looks impressive and rolls the weakest — three watered-down stats

disposition.note: Every rolled value is multiplied by disposition, so the same stat is worth three times more on a 1.55 weapon than on a 0.5 one. Disposition moves inversely to how much a weapon is used, which is why the strongest weapons roll the weakest rivens.

mechanics.never_negative_note: These five can only ever appear as positives, so they can never be the harmless negative you are hoping for.

gun_crit.why: multiplies every crit and is the single largest damage stat on a crit gun
pushes you toward and past the next crit tier, which is a step change rather than a slope
a flat multiplier on damage AND status output, and it stacks with Galvanized Chamber
the base every other multiplier is applied to

gun_status.why: every extra pellet is another status roll, so this is a status stat as much as a damage one
gets you to guaranteed procs, where Galvanized Aptitude and Condition Overload-style scaling live

worth taking as the third stat once status is already saturated

gun_raw.why: with no crit or status to scale, raw damage and multishot are all that is left
still useful if the weapon crits at all
more shots per second is more damage per second on a weapon with nothing else to scale

melee_crit.why: melee reaches red crits through Blood Rush, and crit damage is what those tiers multiply
the base that Blood Rush multiplies by combo — a small base becomes a huge one
the base under Primed Pressure Point and the elementals

melee_status.why: Condition Overload pays per status type on the target, so saturating status is the build
more targets per swing, and it keeps the combo counter fed
the usual third stat once status is guaranteed

melee_heavy.why: heavy attacks consume the combo as a crit multiplier — this is the payload stat
the base the heavy multiplier is applied to
lets you swing heavy again without rebuilding the whole combo

negatives.note: Ranked best-first. The app removes any that would actually hurt the weapon in front of you.

attributes.note: Straight from the wiki's riven attribute table. Melee and guns share most stats but not all: melee has no Multishot, Zoom, Recoil, Magazine, Ammo, Reload, Projectile Speed or Punch Through, while guns have no Range, Combo or Heavy Attack stats. Critical Damage and faction damage roll on BOTH — an earlier version of this file had them as gun-only.
